description:
Says how well a part of an imported repository is doing and what to do about it.
`zone` is a path prefix (packages/cli/src/webhooks) or a few words ("MFA recovery codes").
Returns, from the last 12 months of history and the current code: a verdict (stable,
active, growing, maintenance, fragile), fixes per feature and per 1000 lines, the
recurring fix themes specific to the zone, giant files and functions, files often
changed without tests, coupled areas, parallel implementations, and recommendations
with the numbers behind each one. No language model is involved.
name: hokmah_zone_health
title: Assess a Feature Zone
